These six styles are byte-for-byte copies of the puget-north 1.0.0 charts pack (nav-*) and bathy pack (fish-*) styles/ directories. Do not edit them.

Exception: the fish-*.json copies also declare the `bathy-coarse` and `dem-coarse` sources (url `mbtiles://bathy-coarse` and `mbtiles://dem-coarse`) that the schema 2 bathy pack ships. No layer uses them yet.
